images.filename: 4 x Snow Avalanches across West Highland Line - geograph.org.uk - 1735929.jpg
images.caption:
4 x Snow Avalanches across West Highland Line The West Highland Line was closed due to avalanches for a few days early March 2010.  There were 4 small-ish ones visible, below the steep slopes of Beinn Odhar (901m),from an A82 lay-by, from where this photo was taken 
The line remained closed for some days due to risk of further avalanches after the heaviest snowfall for some years: Glencoe Ski centre some 25 Km further North had 80cm in 24 hours.
images.alt:
4 x Snow Avalanches across West Highland Line The West Highland Line was closed due to avalanches for a few days early March 2010.  There were 4 small-ish ones visible, below the steep slopes of Beinn Odhar (901m),from an A82 lay-by, from where this photo was taken 
The line remained closed for some days due to risk of further avalanches after the heaviest snowfall for some years: Glencoe Ski centre some 25 Km further North had 80cm in 24 hours.
